Unlovable: Prompt-Based Web Application Builder

Unlovable lets anyone generate an application from a prompt. It uses Turborepo, Expo, E2B sandbox and Redis. Try the live demo or view the source code.

Unlovable: Prompt-Based Mobile Application Builder

The mobile version of Unlovable generates a mobile application from a prompt. It is built with React Native, Expo, Nativewind and EAS.

Exness: Crypto CFD Trading Application

This Exness project is a CFD application for trading cryptocurrencies. It uses Turborepo, Redis Pub-Sub and TimescaleDB. See the live demo or the source code.

Exness: Crypto CFD Mobile Application

The Exness mobile app is a CFD application for trading cryptocurrencies on a phone. It uses React Native, Expo, Nativewind and EAS.
